name: Geovis Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Geovis Technology Co.,Ltd operates as an aerospace information technology company in China. It offers space-based and air-based capabilities; and aerospace information service system that integrates data, computing, and applications. The company also provides software sales and data services, technology development and services, and specialized equipment and system integration; online operational services; aerospace big data, low-altitude digital infrastructure, low-altitude planning, low-altitude flight management, and unified flight operations; as well as flexible service models such as cloud service subscriptions and customized value-added services.
